As on June 30, 2026, 15,50,99,910 shares having a face value of Re 1/- each allotted by way of preferential issue and held by A2R Holdings are locked in pursuant to regulation 167 (Part V) of Chapter V of SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018.

The said shares rank pari passu with the existing Equity Shares in all respects.
